mechanism_comparison.circle_realification: Self-inversive boundary values become real after a fixed half-angle phase.
mechanism_comparison.alternation: The comparison q=z^n-c matches leading and constant coefficients, so violation on every gap creates too many nonzero circle roots of g-q.
mechanism_comparison.chord_transfer: A positive normal derivative of log|g| pushes the chord maximum to the chosen arc.
mechanism_comparison.sharpness_boundary: The regular polygon gives uniform arc constant 2 and shows the plain chord method cannot reach rho approaching one.
mechanism_comparison.open_extension: Adapt the comparison polynomial to the zero distribution or use a path family that reaches the regular-polygon extremal configuration.
